---
title: "physiological_variability_by_participant"
format: html
editor: source
---

Each participant-variable bucket with a non-missing mean counts as **one
measurement**, whether it contains one or five observations. Missing means are
excluded; GPS coordinates are included. Reader date defaults apply when loading.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
triggerR <- new.env()
source("R/read_data.R", local = triggerR)
if (!exists("trigger_5min")) trigger_5min <- triggerR$read_trigger_5min()
trigger_5min <- triggerR$drop_suspect(trigger_5min)
```

```{r}
phisiology <- trigger_5min %>%
  select(origin, userId, bucket_5min, variable, mean) %>%
  filter(origin %in% c("smartwatchhigh", "smartwatchlow"),
         !is.na(mean)) %>%
  group_by(origin, userId, variable) %>%
  mutate(buckets = n_distinct(bucket_5min)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r, fig.width=28, fig.height=28}
phisiology %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = userId, y = mean, fill = buckets)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.33, outlier.alpha = 0.33, alpha = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "sqrt", name = "Observed buckets") +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "Five-minute mean") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16)) 
```
